A1.justification: Both PDFs describe GenMatter and contain readable main text and Appendices A–G across 25 pages. Corresponding text, equations, algorithms, figures and tables support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: Sections 5.1–5.3 report original human psychophysics, camouflaged-object segmentation and video-tracking results. Appendix G includes additional quantitative video evaluations.

after.justification: v2 retains the original psychophysics, segmentation and tracking results, including ablations and the supplementary video evaluations in Appendix G.

M1.justification: The hierarchical particle/cluster model, feature augmentation, initialization and blocked-Gibbs tracking procedures remain unchanged. The isolated Appendix B equation discrepancy does not establish a procedural revision; Algorithms 1–2 retain their steps.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same RDK judgments, camouflaged rotating objects, TAP-Vid-DAVIS tracking and ten supplementary deformable-video sequences. No datasets, domains or task scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: FlowSAM remains the RDK comparator; the Gestalt comparison retains FlowSAM and SegAnyMo; RGB tracking and supplementary video comparisons retain CoTracker3. Comparator membership is unchanged within each experiment.

E3.justification: Study sizes, 96×96 Gestalt evaluation, 100 probes per frame, 500-particle RGB comparisons, initialization conditions and evaluation metrics remain unchanged. Appendices E–G preserve the same preprocessing and inference schedules.

E4.justification: Both retain the hierarchy and depth ablations, SAM-versus-ground-truth initialization comparison, subsampling/runtime analysis and supplementary solid/liquid examples. No analytical questions or associated evidence are added or removed.

E5.justification: Both report 50 GenMatter seeds per RDK stimulus, 95% bootstrap intervals using 50,000 samples, and the same correlation and paired significance tests. Uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1–3 and the accompanying findings match. Examples include RDK r² = 0.86, Gestalt accuracy/Jaccard of 0.94/0.72, and SAM-initialized tracking Jm of 0.79 versus CoTracker3's 0.78. Qualitative figures retain the same results.

T1.justification: In Appendix B, the cluster-mean minimization changes its summation index from ell in H_k to n in B_ell, while retaining the particle-mean summand and the solution averaging over H_k. This introduces a localized mathematical inconsistency. The preceding loss and Algorithm 2 retain the original cluster averaging.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and discussion retain the same contributions: unified motion-based perception, human-like perceptual uncertainty, structure recovery in camouflage, and competitive tracking without task-specific training.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and limitations remain unchanged, including complete occlusion, fixed particle counts, 2D proxies for 3D evaluation, weak liquid tracking and the SAM-based pseudo-ground-truth caveat in Appendix G.2.

D1.justification: The GenJAX implementation, NVIDIA L4 hardware, initialization, hyperparameters, feature preprocessing and experimental schedules remain documented identically. Project access information is also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, comparisons with prior approaches and all 66 reference entries remain unchanged. No cited work or substantive research positioning is added or removed.

P1.justification: The section structure and narrative are retained. Besides the updated arXiv stamp, v2 drops 'of' from 'a range of stuff and things' in Appendix G.2, introducing a small grammatical error.

P2.justification: v2 removes printed page numbers throughout and makes small local spacing and line-wrapping changes. Figures 1–12 and Tables 1–3 retain their content, captions, organization and placement.

improvement.justification: v2 introduces an incorrect summation index in Appendix B, weakening the derivation's mathematical consistency. The intended update remains recoverable from the unchanged averaging expression and Algorithm 2, limiting the harm. The remaining changes are cosmetic or introduce a small grammatical error; the empirical evidence and core method remain unchanged.
